title: Taipower to pour NT$109.6 billion into grid for TSMC-led chip boom in southern Taiwan
html:
Taiwan Power Company (Taipower) plans to invest NT$109.6 billion (US$3.33 billion) in power transmission and transformation infrastructure to meet surging electricity demand from semiconductor manufacturers expanding in southern Taiwan...

Credit: DIGITIMES
